title: Fix 272
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-040 already names journal add among the commands that hold the writer lock; only the code and its test change.
acceptance_criteria: While another process holds .chough/local/checkpoint.lock, chough journal add waits and writes no post; once the lock is released it writes its post and a feed that lists it. chough library index --check passes after concurrent journal adds.
